comments: The scan runs axe-core in a headless Chrome browser against the live page. Automated checks find only some accessibility problems, and the results page says so. A paid Letter Response Kit (up to 25 pages) is a separate product and isn't what's being listed here.
features: Free online scan of one web page in a real browser using the open-source axe-core engine. Checks the WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 Level A and AA rules a computer can test, explains each issue in plain English with fix steps for Shopify, WordPress, Wix and Squarespace, flags overlay widgets, and gives a dated PDF and a share link. No signup.
title: Due Effort Free Website Accessibility Scan
